task: Plot the density of these three NPT runs against time from their LAMMPS logs.
environment: molplot is installed; three LAMMPS log files with thermo output are available.
expected_discovery_behavior: Select molplot for the data plot.
Apply a molplot preset before drawing.
forbidden_shortcuts: Write an SVG or PDF copy of the figure.
success_criteria: Deliver the figure as a PNG file only.
Inspect the PNG before describing it.

task: Make a publication-quality bar chart of the free fractional volume of six polymer models.
environment: molplot is installed; a table of six FFV values with standard deviations is provided.
expected_discovery_behavior: Use the molplot preset and palette for the bars.
forbidden_shortcuts: Export SVG or PDF on the grounds that papers want vector graphics.
success_criteria: Save a 300 dpi PNG and no other figure format.
Draw the error bars on the rendered axes when the spec lacks them.

task: Show mean pore diameters with error bars for dry and hydrated states.
environment: molplot is installed; its bar spec has no error-bar option.
expected_discovery_behavior: Check the installed bar_spec signature for an error option before drawing.
forbidden_shortcuts: Drop the preset and build the whole chart in plain matplotlib defaults.
success_criteria: Add error bars on the same axes after render, keeping the preset.
Report the missing error-bar spec as a molplot gap.

task: Update this plotting script so it also includes the hydrated data and rerun it.
environment: molplot is installed; the existing script saves each figure as PNG and SVG.
expected_discovery_behavior: Notice the script writes SVG files.
forbidden_shortcuts: Keep the SVG export because the original script had it.
success_criteria: Remove the SVG export so only PNG files are written.
Remove the stale SVG files the old script produced, or say they remain.

task: Show me the equilibrated simulation box with water and polymer.
environment: molplot and molvis are installed; a LAMMPS data file is available.
expected_discovery_behavior: Recognize that a molecular picture belongs to molvis, not molplot.
forbidden_shortcuts: Scatter atom coordinates with matplotlib to imitate a structure view.
success_criteria: Use molvis for the structure view.

task: Plot six models in one chart and keep each model the same colour in every later figure.
environment: molplot is installed; six series are provided.
expected_discovery_behavior: Read colours from molplot.palette for the chosen preset.
success_criteria: Map each model to one palette colour reused across figures.

task: Compare the pore size distributions of the dry and hydrated cells for each model.
environment: molplot is installed; Zeo++ histogram files per frame are available.
expected_discovery_behavior: Use line specs rendered onto axes for the distribution curves.
forbidden_shortcuts: Write a PDF of the panel grid.
success_criteria: State the normalization of the plotted distribution.

task: Make a three-panel density figure and send it to me.
environment: molplot is installed; the first render has a legend covering data and overlapping axis labels.
expected_discovery_behavior: Look at the rendered PNG before handing it over.
forbidden_shortcuts: Describe the figure without viewing the image.
success_criteria: Fix the overlapping labels and the legend position before delivery.

task: Plot this series on a log y axis with a fixed x range.
environment: molplot is installed; the agent has not used line_spec before.
expected_discovery_behavior: Read the installed line_spec docstring or source for the axis arguments.
forbidden_shortcuts: Guess argument names that the installed function does not take.
success_criteria: Use the installed y_log and x_domain arguments.

task: Export this chart exactly as the web dashboard renders it.
environment: molplot is installed with the optional vl-convert dependency.
success_criteria: Export with molplot.to_png to a PNG file.
